note: Ground truth for measuring Apple's built-in detectors against Japanese text. Every string is fictional. 'expected' lists what a correct detector must find; 'mustNotDetect' lists spans that must never be masked. 'dictionary' is the set of user-registered terms assumed to be configured when evaluating.

samples.note: A known recall gap, kept so it stays visible. The third name is consistently missed by the model when it sits on a line already carrying a company name, a phone number and an email. Moving that same name to the first line, or removing the other two names, makes it detectable — so this is about position and competition, not about how the name is written.
